summary: Albania protects close relatives (children, spouse, parents) with a reserved share that a will cannot remove. Albania has no trust law and is not party to the Hague Trusts Convention. Private foundations exist only as non-profit entities.
reserved_share: Children, spouse and parents of the deceased are compulsory heirs under the Civil Code (Law 7850/1994); the exact fraction was not confirmed.
foreign_law_note: Law 10428/2011 on private international law governs succession conflicts; whether a foreign national resident may choose their national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: No domestic trust law; foreign trusts are not recognised by treaty. Foundations are non-profit bodies under Law 8788/2001 on non-profit organisations.
open_questions: Compulsory share fraction and article numbers in the Civil Code.
Choice-of-law rule in Law 10428/2011 for foreign nationals.
